title: 第13章 赤血妖熊血灵芝第14章 击杀妖熊炼化妖丹
content_zh:
“少爷，前面这个应该就是赤血妖熊的洞府了。”
看着眼前巨大的洞府，叶无尘已经能想到那妖熊的身躯有多么庞大了。
两人走到那妖兽的洞府旁，叶无尘让叶夕月守在洞口接应他，而自己则去山洞内探探路。
在叶夕月的注视下，他的身影缓缓走入山洞之中。
山洞里很黑，但叶无尘的双眼早已适应了黑暗，这种环境对他造成不了多大的影响。
“不对劲。”
叶无尘喃喃自语道。
他能明显感受到此地充斥着一股十分浓郁的气血之力。
甚至就连魂宫中的树苗都开始兴奋了起来。
顺着石壁不断前行，一路上，叶无尘都十分小心。
面对炼体九重的妖兽，他可不敢有丝毫大意。
石洞内十分安静，甚至都能听到自己的心跳声。
一连走了好一段路，依旧没有发现任何动静，但周围的气血之力却是越来越浓郁了。
就在此时，叶无尘发现前方不远处竟有淡淡的红光浮现。
而他的魂宫中，那株树苗正不停的摇晃着自己的枝干，显得异常兴奋。
距离慢慢靠近，叶无尘终于看清了那散发着红光的物体究竟是个什么东西。
“血灵芝！”
叶无尘心中暗暗惊呼一声。
武者修行，除了自身的天赋之外，最重要的便是丹药与天材地宝了。
血灵芝便属于天材地宝的范畴之内。

传闻它有生死人，肉白骨的能力，其内蕴含的气血之力堪称恐怖。
当然，那指的是万年以上的血灵芝。
看其大小，此地的血灵芝大概只有百年左右，但其内蕴含的气血之力依旧不俗。
然而此时，叶无尘脸上丝毫不见惊喜的表情。
因为此时他能感受到，自己的身后似乎有一道若有若无的呼吸声。
一点一点的将头转向身后，黑暗中，一头妖熊正戏谑的盯着自己。
“炼体九重，赤血妖熊。”
叶无尘的瞳孔收缩了一下。
逃跑的道路被赤血妖熊那庞大的身躯堵住。
它似乎并不着急这么快就杀死自己的猎物，那巨大的身躯缓缓朝叶无尘靠近。
在赤血妖熊眼里，叶无尘俨然已经是它的食物，对于食物，它不介意多给一点耐心。
但此时的叶无尘眼中却未见丝毫慌乱，在炼体三重的时候他便能越级击败炼体五重的妖兽。
如今自己已经是炼体六重，这炼体九重的妖熊也未尝不可一战。
与此同时，赤血妖熊已经来到叶无尘的身前。
只见它抬起自己那巨大的爪子，猛然朝前方的叶无尘拍去。
熊掌未至，叶无尘便能感受到一阵猛烈的掌风。
但他依旧不惧，催动全身气血，伏世拳轰杀而出，与对方的巨掌撞击在一起。
这一瞬间，叶无尘只感觉似乎有一座大山压在他身上一般，强大的力道让他不由得暴退数步。
“好强的力道。”
叶无尘的右手一阵发麻，甚至感觉要脱臼了一样。

以他如今的实力，单独面对炼体九重的妖兽还是太过勉强了。
content_en:
"Master, this should be the cave of the red-blooded demon bear."
Looking at the huge cave in front of him, Ye Wuchen could already imagine how huge the body of the demon bear was.
The two of them walked to the monster's cave. Ye Wuchen asked Ye Xiyue to stay at the entrance of the cave to meet him, while he went to explore the cave.
Under Ye Xiyue's gaze, his figure slowly walked into the cave.
It was very dark in the cave, but Ye Wuchen's eyes had already adapted to the darkness, so this environment did not have much impact on him.
"Something's wrong."
Ye Wuchen murmured to himself.
He could clearly feel that this place was filled with a very strong energy and blood.
Even the saplings in the Soul Palace started to get excited.
Ye Wuchen continued to move forward along the stone wall. Along the way, Ye Wuchen was very careful.
Facing the monster beast at the ninth level of body refining, he did not dare to be careless in the slightest.
It was so quiet inside the cave that you could even hear your own heartbeat.
After walking for a long time, I still didn't find any movement, but the power of Qi and blood around me was getting stronger and stronger.
At this moment, Ye Wuchen discovered that there was a faint red light emerging not far ahead.
In his soul palace, the sapling was shaking its branches, looking extremely excited.
As the distance gradually approached, Ye Wuchen finally saw clearly what the object emitting red light was.
"Blood Ganoderma!"
Ye Wuchen secretly exclaimed in his heart.
In martial arts practice, apart from one's own talent, the most important thing is elixirs and heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
Blood Ganoderma belongs to the category of natural materials and earthly treasures.
It is rumored that it has the ability to resurrect people, flesh and bones, and the power of energy and blood contained in it is terrifying.
Of course, that refers to the Blood Ganoderma that is over ten thousand years old.
Judging from its size, the Blood Ganoderma here is probably only about a hundred years old, but the power of Qi and blood contained in it is still impressive.
However, at this time, there was no expression of surprise on Ye Wuchen's face.
Because at this time, he could feel that there seemed to be a vague sound of breathing behind him.
Turning his head behind him little by little, in the darkness, a demon bear was staring at him teasingly.
"Ninth level of body refining, red-blooded demon bear."
Ye Wuchen's pupils shrank.
The way to escape was blocked by the huge body of the red-blooded demon bear.
It didn't seem to be in a hurry to kill its prey so quickly, and its huge body slowly approached Ye Wuchen.
In the eyes of the red-blooded demon bear, Ye Wuchen was already its food, and it didn't mind being a little more patient with its food.
But at this time, Ye Wuchen didn't see any panic in his eyes. When he was at the third level of body refining, he was able to leapfrog and defeat the monster beast at the fifth level of body refining.
Now that he is at the sixth level of body refining, it is not impossible for him to fight against the demon bear at the ninth level of body refining.
At the same time, the red-blooded demon bear had arrived in front of Ye Wuchen.
It was seen raising its huge claws and suddenly slapping Ye Wuchen in front.
Before the bear's paw arrived, Ye Wuchen could feel a fierce wind from the palm.
But he was still not afraid. He activated his energy and blood, and the Fu Shi Fist shot out, colliding with the opponent's giant palm.
At this moment, Ye Wuchen felt as if there was a big mountain pressing on him, and the powerful force made him take several steps back.
"So strong."
Ye Wuchen's right hand felt numb, and even felt like it was about to be dislocated.
With his current strength, it is still too much to face the monsters at the ninth level of body refining alone.
